text:
ria: Scanned partner onboarding bundle and found archives still encrypted with onboard-v1 wrap key + a vendor SA JSON inside one tar. marking as potential prod-impact.

security-bot: Alert: artifact-scan match=onboard-v1+sajson object=partner_uploads/partner-qa-2026-11-03.tgz (hits=1).

devon: If SA is in prod, immediate steps: remove roles from SA, delete keys, revoke any Vault tokens, and plan a transit rewrap for affected archives.

alina: I'll take rewrap and audit forwarding. plan: create new wrap key version, rewrap archives, publish signed manifest to s3://secure-analytics/rewraps/INC-6176543210/manifest.json, and forward unwrap events to SIEM for 90d. throttling at 6/min.

ben: I'll handle RBAC: apply a temporary org-policy deny for that SA and remove project roles. commands: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=vendor-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'
for k in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=vendor-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format='value(name)'); do gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete "$k" --iam-account=vendor-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true; done
# quick deny
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:vendor-onboard-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/editor || true
```

infra: Agreed. I'll also add a conditional bucket deny for partner IPs if they tried to fetch objects. Will schedule KMS key version creation at 22:00 UTC to avoid quota spikes.

ria: Vendor paused distribution after we asked. They provided a partial MD5 list of files. Good to proceed.

alina: Rewrap started: 4 archives queued, throttle 6/min. snippet used: 
```
python tools/rewrap.py --old-key projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-v1 --new-key projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-v2 --input-list manifests/partner-archives.txt --out=out/rewrap-manifest.json
```

security-bot: Incident created INC-6176543210 "onboard bundle wrapkey exposure" severity=P1 assigned to eng-security.

devon: Also run a quick grep for SA JSONs in partner buckets: 
```
zgrep -aE '"client_email"|"private_key"' partner-buckets/*/*.gz || true
```

alina: Rewrap complete 4/4, manifest uploaded and signed. shared checksums with vendor; they confirmed they removed old bundles and will re-pull only after verification.

ben: Revoked Vault tokens that mentioned vendor SA and enforced require_mfa=true on the reissue role for 72h.

infra: Applied conditional deny on bucket and scheduled KMS rotation tomorrow night for the wrap key to create a clean boundary.

ria: Postmortem owners: ria+alina. Follow-ups: 1) add pre-upload artifact scanner for vendor bundles, 2) vendor onboarding checklist update (forbid SA JSON), 3) run rotation drill next quarter. I'll file tickets. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
